_about: Revit families (.rfa) added to the catalogue by scripts/upload-revit-families.mjs. 'attach' adds the family to an existing product (brand + name), so one card serves SketchUp and Revit. 'new' creates a Revit-only product. Paths are relative to D:\Dirory. Thumbnails: the vendor's photo where there is one; otherwise the family's own preview, enlarged (library-additions/Revit/thumbnails) - replace those with product photos when they exist.
